name: Large Repository Indexing
description: Implement incremental indexing for large repositories (100k+ files). Index files in priority order: recently modified first, project entry points first. Use a background worker that yields between batches to avoid blocking the UI. Track indexing progress and expose it to the user. Support pause, resume, and cancel of active indexing operations.
purpose: Large repositories cannot be indexed synchronously without freezing the UI. Incremental indexing with progress tracking ensures the workspace is usable immediately while indexing catches up in the background. Priority ordering means the most relevant files are indexed first.
acceptanceCriteria: Indexing processes files in configurable batch sizes, yielding between batches
Recent files are indexed before older files
Project entry points (entrypoint files, config files, build files) are indexed before all others
Indexing runs in a background worker, does not block the UI thread
Indexing progress is visible to the user (percent complete, files indexed, estimated time remaining)
Indexing can be paused, resumed, and canceled
Already-indexed state is persisted — resuming does not re-index from scratch
New/created files are indexed incrementally without full re-index
Files modified during indexing are picked up by the next batch
